findings.summary: The claim that generated frontend directories are unignored omits the tracked root .gitignore. Its node_modules/ and dist/ rules apply to frontend descendants; git check-ignore --no-index reports both frontend/node_modules/example.js and frontend/dist/example.html as ignored. No frontend/.gitignore duplication is needed.
findings.evidence: repository root .gitignore lines 1 and 4; lead git check-ignore command recorded in external continuation log

findings.summary: test:browser invokes Playwright only while its configured web server serves existing dist/. A source edit after a previous build can therefore pass browser tests against stale output rather than current static artifacts.
